programme.desc: Not easy to enjoy a DVD about salmon when the Lemmings are having a disco party right there. Grizzy sends them packing with such force that they land at the research station, where they discover a state-of-the-art U.V. cabin. When turned up to the max, the light therapy and music options can advantageously replace the disco equipment Grizzy destroyed. The noise they make causes a block of ice to break off. It hurdles down the slope to the cabin and destroys Grizzy’s TV.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (24)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun destroying ice towers. When Grizzy sees them, it inspires him to sculpt statues of himself. The Lemmings cannot resist the temptation to destroy the statues of Grizzy, who does everything in his power to protect them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (25)
programme.desc: A container adrift along the icefield will change the lives of Grizzy and the Lemmings: it’s an inexhaustible stock of chocolate spread! There is so much, that for the first time the close enemies have no need to fight over the treat. They entice a flock of penguins into hoisting the container out of the water. One of the penguins, who did not get his reward in fish, is disgruntled. Grizzy has him taste the Yummy, then throws the jar far away to get rid of the penguin.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (26)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses a fire extinguisher to chase the Lemmings from the living room so that he can take a nap, but the gadget accidentally flies out the window. It lands at the top of an ice cliff, causing a fissure, and the peak of the cliff topples. Amid the debris, the Lemmings discover a fearsome creature: the Yeti, who is looking for the guilty party. The Lemmings bring him to Grizzy, never dreaming that the giant will immediately fall in love with the Ranger’s cabin and throw a very original party.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (27)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings are bored. A coconut rolls over to Grizzy’s feet, pulling the bear out of his state of torpor. He imagines a sort of face on the nut and decides to care for it, like a child with its doll. He has so much fun playing with his new toy that the Lemmings want to join in. But when the bear refuses, the Lemmings ruse: they hide inside other coconuts in hopes of being adopted by Grizzy!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (28)
programme.desc: While bickering with the Lemmings over control of the TV, Grizzy sees an illustration that gives him an idea. In a medical book, a person whose leg is in a cast is being served dinner in front of a TV. Grizzy pretends to have a twisted ankle and shows the Lemmings the patient care illustrations. The imaginary invalid Grizzy is so convincing that the Lemmings fall for the trick. They think that the sooner Grizzy is healed, the sooner they will be able to throw him out of the cabin as planned.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (29)
programme.desc: On the beach, the Lemmings have set up a mini funfair for tourists. Each attraction lets you to win tickets, which are then used to collect prizes from a vending machine. Grizzy, who is not very good at games of skill, steals the tickets collected by the Lemmings in order to obtain the jackpot. The Lemmings decide to create an attraction just for him.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (31)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (32)
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (34)
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (16)
programme.desc: Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation - but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (17)
programme.desc: Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints - pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (18)
programme.desc: When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (19)
programme.desc: Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy - the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput (34)
programme.desc: Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Moley (42)
programme.desc: All of MoleTown goes into a cleaning frenzy after Moley tries to explain why humans in the Great Above think dirt is dirty!

programme.title: Moley (43)
programme.desc: Moley tries to impress the new ambassador from MoleTown’s sister city, Moledonia, meanwhile the Gardener has schemed up a free tour in order to get his hands on Manny.

programme.title: Moley (44)
programme.desc: It’s winter in MoleTown and a mysterious snowy creature is roaming the Big Below, the Gardener uses this as the perfect opportunity to try and scare Moley with his own Abominable Snowmole, and catch Manny.

programme.title: Moley (45)
programme.desc: All of MoleTown enjoys a day at the beach. But when they found out Mona Lisa can’t swim, Mishmosh comes to the rescue with his new submarine invention!

programme.title: Moley (46)
programme.desc: MoleTown’s orchestra is performing, and everyone is impressed with Milo’s new hat until Moley accidentally breaks it. Moley must come up with a way to get Milo’s hat back to normal and fast!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry (2)
programme.desc: Tom & Jerry take their chase to the skies. Kite-flying has never been this intense. Who will emerge as the ultimate master of strings?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (5)
programme.desc: Chep and Mush-Mush sometimes don’t listen to Lilit. So when she tries to tell them about her great idea to have a special firefly night, they instead believe it is their idea. Grrr! Whose special firefly night will come out on top?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (6)
programme.desc: Bolly hurts his foot and can’t go fast until it heals. Phooey! But when everyone gives him treats to cheer him up, Bolly decides he never wants his foot to heal.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (7)
programme.desc: Chep is over-joyed when his weevil friend, Chase, returns to Mushton. But Chase seems to have changed, he's way harder to handle now. And he wants something from Chep! But what?

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (8)
programme.desc: Chep has to give the Mushlets a talk about spiders. But talking in front of a group makes Chep nervous. Mush-Mush offers to do it instead. Problem is Mush-Mush’s knowledge of spiders is so bad he ends up getting caught by one!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (9)
programme.desc: The Mushlers want Amanita to join in telling monster stories. But Amanita doesn’t believe in monsters. So they take her on a monster hunt and find more than they imagined.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (51)
programme.desc: Kid Fury is trapped in the Titan Fury, which is advancing towards Kaboom City. Kid Kazoom and Multy risk everything to rescue him before it's too late.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (26)
programme.desc: Old Snelgrove, the senior butler, is retiring. There is an open backyard Olympics on the estate to see who will replace him. When the contestants in the field are narrowed down to Butch and Tom, what will the final outcome be?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (27)
programme.desc: Red Herring complains to Tom and Jerry that he keeps hearing laughter everywhere he goes. Tom and Jerry bodyguard Red to prevent him from doing anything that might provoke laughter, but Red's goof-ups and fails soon have even them convulsed. Gradually, it gets loud enough that Tom and Jerry can hear it too. Will they find the true source of the laughter?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (28)
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry awake to the smell of eggs being cooked in the kitchen - Ginger and Rick are making breakfast courtesy of their neighbor's fresh eggs. Ginger and Rick talk about how their new neighbor has a suburban henhouse and is raising their own produce. Tom and Jerry team up to target the henhouse for a heist, but it's easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (29)
programme.desc: A little baby goat butts his head through a distant wall of the estate and starts nibbling the grass. At first, he helps Tom with the yardwork but then causes chaos throughout the manor. Tom and Jerry are left to deal with the kid.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (30)
programme.desc: On another scary night in the castle, The Invisible Cat wants nothing more than to catch mice. After it picks up and carries Jerry and Tuffy, Tom is really confused (and spooked) to see the two mice "magically" float through the air! When Tom accidentally smacks The Invisible Cat in the face and knocks Jerry and Tuffy free of his hold, it sparks a slapstick fight between the two cats.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (33)
programme.desc: The Lemmings open a nightclub with blasting music and a disco ball in an igloo they have built not far from the cabin. The noise prevents Grizzy from sleeping. The bear confiscates the disco ball and propels the Lemmings far into the distance. They land in an ice cave where they discover a console that lights up the stars in the sky and controls the northern lights. The canopy of heaven starts blinking. The Lemmings transform the ice field into an open-air discotheque!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (34)
programme.desc: The Lemmings come up with a ride worthy of a county fair in the living room. Awakened, Grizzy throws their juice extractor out the window and the rodents land in the neighboring science station where they accidentally wake up… a mammoth! A friendship is born between them. The Lemmings drag the mastodon into their game, and he transforms the entire cabin into a Ferris Wheel. Grizzy, who was trying to doze in peace, wakes up in a panic.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (35)
programme.desc: Before an audience of penguins and walruses, two teams of Lemmings perform acrobatic high jumps, competing for the winning prize. When Grizzy accidentally jumps in, he quickly gets caught up in the game and the clapometer goes wild! Intoxicated by his victory, the bear is by no means a modest winner! But the Lemmings want their moment of glory in the limelight as well!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (7)
programme.desc: Alone in the jungle, Clara Tinhorn wrestles with her loneliness, until she stumbles upon a freshly hatched baby crocodile!She names the hatchling Lenny, and the two quickly bond in playful joy! When the Ranchers arrive to check on the crocodile nest, they discover the baby is gone! Furious, the mother croc, Snapfang, unleashes her wrath on the Ranchers, convinced they’ve stolen her child!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (8)
programme.desc: The Ranchers dive deep across the ocean floor, determined to track down Jack’s long-lost rusty anchor! Their search is a success, but the moment they reach for it, the water explodes with motion! A massive plesiosaur charges at them, sending the Ranchers close to the wreck of an ancient ship! Just when a collision seems certain, the beast halts, spooked by something lurking in the depths!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (9)
programme.desc: Sometimes Mr. Bean’s Teddy can be no fun at all. Feeling the need for a new friend, Bean buys a parrot. But getting the parrot past his landlady and her one-eyed cat, Scrapper, proves to be no easy task. Next, is trying to get the blasted bird to speak.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (10)
programme.desc: It’s a beautiful day at the beach. Bean breathes in the salty air, bliss - and not another soul in sight. What could possibly spoil his perfect day? Answer: British weather. Mr. Bean finds himself chasing an illusive ray of sunshine across town, over hills and dales, a football stadium and the English Channel.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (29)
programme.desc: While eating breakfast, the Baby Lemmings discover a hot stone near a spring that enables them to cook their food. They find it incredible and decide to start cooking. Baby Owl, asleep nearby, is attracted by the smell and plunders their feast!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: Baby Lynx is desperately looking for a worthy opponent to race against. When she sees the Baby Lemmings chasing an apple rolling down a slope, she wants to race against them. But in reality, they are really bad at it! Baby Lynx decides to train the Baby Lemmings in the hope of having real opponents.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (20)
programme.desc: When they fall into a hollow tree stump, the baby lemmings discover the principle of echoes. They have fun making lots of noise and even humming a little because it's so much fun! But they don't realize that when they sing (in tune), it causes the flowers around them to bloom. Meanwhile, the owl would like the noise to stop so she can finally get some sleep. She is determined to silence her noisy neighbors.

programme.title: Batwheels (10)
programme.desc: To ease the burden on MOE, the Batwheels use his duplicating machine to make copies of their repair bot, but the Batcave is soon overrun when the machine breaks!

programme.title: Batwheels (12)
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean meets an aristocratic old lady when he nearly runs over her lapdog with his mini. He’s thrilled to be invited for luncheon at her grand but strangely shabby mansion. Bean is determined to rise to the occasion. He’s so busy with matters of protocol he doesn’t notice that the lady and her sinister butler aren’t quite what they seem…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night - but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish - and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: The gang tours an old Hollywood Studio, but they soon uncover a mystery concerning the ghost of a silent film comedy star who has returned to make sure his recently discovered final film is never seen!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (14)
programme.desc: Fred lives out his childhood dream of being a stage magician as he and the gang go uncover at a private magic club being terrorized by a mutant Rabbit monster!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (60)
programme.desc: While fighting over a jelly cake, Grizzy banishes the Lemmings to the castle dungeons and the rodents discover a passageway leading to a secret elfin room.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (61)
programme.desc: The Lemmings take Polaroid snapshots of themselves disguised outside the castle along with a sheep who poses with them.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (62)
programme.desc: Grizzy is pulled out of his dreams by the rambunctious Lemmings who are jousting on sheep.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (63)
programme.desc: With a ring that lets their astral bodies travel, the Lemmings decide to haunt Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (64)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over a giant jelly cake. Their chase leads them to the castle library, where the Lemmings accidentally activate the opening of a secret passage.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (65)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a card that enables them to teleport a magic closet.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (2)
programme.desc: After seeing the flashy electric go-kart Mr Paliwal has bought for his daughter Divya, Mr Bean and Billy build their own using items around Mrs Wicket’s garden. At the go-kart track, Mr Bean and Mr Paliwal are unimpressed with Billy and Divya’s driving skills so take the karts for a “proper” race around the park. Meanwhile Mrs Wicket is on the warpath when she finds things missing from her house.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (3)
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy head to the bowling alley with a free voucher, but Mr Bean finds it a lot harder than he expected. Seeing a little girl with a smaller ball, he borrows it, thinking it will be easier to use. But instead, he gets his fingers stuck in the ball and he causes havoc trying to pull them out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (4)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is at a farmers’ market with Irma at her knitwear stall - right next to a man selling novelty teapots. Bean is instantly smitten with a green car-shaped one but can’t afford it. When he visits a food truck that’s laid out free samples, he hatches a plan to swipe them and sell them on his own stall so he can raise the cash for the teapot of his dreams!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (5)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase - “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (48)
programme.desc: Mr Bean joins Billy in trying to film his remote-controlled car so they can win an online video competition. But Mrs Wicket interrupts, asking them to set up the garden for Uncle Ron’s birthday party. While she’s off picking him up, they use the furniture to create the ultimate course for their video, but a wonky wheel on the car sends it straight into Ron’s massive birthday cake!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: When did Mr. Bean first meet his teddy bear? Did he really learn to drive his mini at the age of ten? Could he possibly have known his battle-axe of a landlady when she was a sweet and blushing bride? Bean takes us on a journey into the past, answering these questions and giving us an inkling as to what made him the man he is today.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (7)
programme.desc: Jerry puts Tuffy to sleep but Tuffy sneaks out to play in his dollhouse. Tom sees Tuffy and tries to catch him. Tuffy and Jerry dress up in costumes to try and escape Tom. Tom chases them into the dollhouse but he is too big and ends up wearing the house instead.

programme.title: Batwheels (5)
programme.desc: When Bam is covered in super bouncy Bounce X goo during a chase with Prank, he must learn to embrace and use his newfound bouncing abilities to his advantage if he's going to put a stop to Prank's latest scheme.

programme.title: Batwheels (12)
programme.desc: The Batwheels are shocked to discover that a crime wave taking place in Gotham is being perpetrated by someone very familiar...

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (8)
programme.desc: Robin's ride Redbird is on the case in this radical music video, as he sneaks and sleuths his way to stop Gotham's villains with his speed and detective skills - it's no mystery why Redbird is one of the best!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (10)
programme.desc: Shaggy and Scooby's favorite chef is finally opening his own restaurant but a monstrous Yeti threatens the opening night. The gang has to solve the mystery before dessert is served, while Shaggy and Scooby have to resist eating all the food that's meant for the customers!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (11)
programme.desc: Daphne had always dreamed of meeting extraterrestrial life, but that dream becomes a nightmare when the gang gets caught up in the mystery of a scary alien monster and brought to Area 53 - a government facility so secret, it's two numbers higher than Area 51!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (10)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover a very particular cocoa tree with chocolate-spread sap! Reduced to eating canned Brussels sprouts, the only remaining food in the cabin, Grizzy is baffled when he sees the Lemmings parading past to equip themselves with all sorts of containers: ladles, soup spoons, bowls, buckets, basins, etc. He watches them through binoculars and discovers that they have planted a faucet in a tree where chocolate spread flows. Grizzy decides to siphon off their tree.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (11)
programme.desc: Grizzy expels the Lemmings from the cabin where they had built a cumbersome obstacle course. Peaceful at last and feeling lazy, he is determined not to leave his couch. The Lemmings discover a magic Mayan disc that allows you to choose instantaneous mutations of other animals’ features: bat wings, reindeer antlers, elephant trunks, etc. The mutant Lemmings return to the cabin, determined to continue playing their game while enjoying their new accessories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (12)
programme.desc: As they fight over the last jar of chocolate spread, Grizzy and the Lemmings accidentally send it flying deep into the jungle. They both set out in search for the jar, but in a forest that dense, it’s an impossible mission. In a Mayan Temple, the Lemmings discover a magic bracelet that increases one’s sense of smell tenfold and use it to find the jar. Grizzy loses their trail, but finds some Mayan bracelets himself: one for eyesight and one for hearing.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (28)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings discover a strange gateway to a parallel world. On the other side, there is the same cabin, only it doesn't belong to a ranger. It's a chocolate spread museum, where the curators are... another Grizzy and other Lemmings, all with very different personalities.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (29)
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings clumsily destroy the TV remote control while fighting over who gets to watch their favorite program. While looking for a backup zapper, they happen onto a top secret Canadian Army prototype that enables you to apply the usual controls: "play," "pause" and "fast forward" to living beings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (30)
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that by changing the speed limit sign on the side of the road, they can accelerate truck traffic and create a huge draft that is just perfect for their extreme kiting game. Grizzy would be more in favor of a "STOP!" or "No Entrance!" sign. A road sign battle begins.

programme.title: Lamput (42)
programme.desc: It's back to basics as Specs attempts to catch Lamput with a net. Not being much good at anything at all physical, Specs ends up whacking himself on his own noggin. The blow shakes loose what little ability Specs had to function as an adult. He's transformed into a wailing infant who requires 24 hour care from his devoted... parents? Skinny and Lamput have to learn on the job. Taking care of a baby is hard. Especially if it's a giant annoying one.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (9)
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (10)
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (2)
programme.desc: Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (51)
programme.desc: Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (4)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (19)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (9)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (9)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: O Mikešovi (17)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (8)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o příhodách spolužáků Macha a Šebestové podle námětu Miloše Macourka. Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (5)
programme.desc: U Maříkova žila chudá vdova, které všichni říkali Dontovka. Na krku měla kupu dětí, a tak dřela od rána do večera. Když jednou sekala louku, šel kolem Krakonoš a dostal chuť na jahody. Ale to si dal! Dontovka ho hnala bez respektu pryč, a to Krakonoše jaksepatří rozzlobilo. Přičaroval jí mohutné vousy a myslel si, bůhvíjak na ni nevyzrál. Jenomže kampak na Dontovku. Okamžitě zarůstající vousy stříhala a spolu s dětmi vyráběla košťata, koberce, záclony. A ženské v okolí popadla závist.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (12)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: O Dorotce (10)
programme.desc: Holčička Dorotka a její věrný kamarád papoušek Koko spolu prožívají různá veselá dobrodružství. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Brundibáři (3)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Pan Jordán a Habada
programme.desc: Mladá učitelka se odmítá smířit se zatuchlými poměry na škole, kde pedagogický sbor ovládá zapšklý despota. Příběh se odehrává v prostředí jedné pražské školy na sklonku předminulého století. Učitelský sbor tu ovládá učitel Jordán, kariérista, který se neštítí ani štvavých, anonymních výpadů v tisku proti byrokratickému inspektorovi Svobodovi a jeho „chráněnci“, učiteli Habadovi, který přišel z venkova. Když se mu to hodí, používá Jordán nevybíravé prostředky.

programme.title: V čertích službách
programme.desc: Honza se musí vydat do světa, aby si našel službu. Nabídne mu ji sám Lucifer. Po roce Honzovi služba v kotelně končí a za odměnu si z pekla odnáší - na radu čerta, s kterým pracoval - kouzelný ubrus. Když ho prostře, nadělí mu jídlo, na jaké si vzpomene. Honza přenocuje u lakomého sedláka a jeho hamižné ženy, ti mu ubrus vymění. Dostat kouzelnou odměnu zpět pomůže Honzovi skřítek, který mu dá hůl, aby zloděje vytrestal. Československá animovaná loutková pohádka

programme.title: Devět kruhů pekla
programme.desc: Příběh lásky na pokraji apokalypsy. Český lékař Tomáš v roce 1979 v Kambodži pátrá po ztracené manželce Khemě. Do exotické země přijel v roce 1969 a zamiloval se do krásné tanečnice proti vůli jejích rodičů. Série státních převratů však šťastný pár rozdělí a Tomáš se setkává jen s troskami svého bývalého života.

programme.title: Druhé mládí
programme.desc: Těžká zkouška donutí bankovního ředitele přemýšlet o pravých hodnotách života. Sentimentální románek o trpící ženě, která se souží manželovými zálety. Spolu s matkou prožívá její životní zklamání i již provdaná dcera, která však není ochotna smiřovat se s rolí pokorné manželky. Bankovní ředitel dr. Fráňa Tobiáš se pokouší zahnat známky postupujícího stáří s pomocí mladé milenky Helgy. Manželka Mira tuší nepříjemnou pravdu, ale stále svého muže miluje a tiše se trápí.

programme.title: Waterloo
programme.desc: Ve vypjaté dramatické situaci jedné červnové noci roku 1815 několik hodin před bitvou, která se zdá předem prohraná, má Napoleon na vybranou: buď jít do bitvy a riskovat, že ji nevyhraje, nebo do bitvy nejít, což ovšem znamená abdikovat. Vzdát se absolutní moci a své vojenské zkušenosti nabídnout lidu, republice... Československé historické drama

programme.title: Pivo přes ulici
programme.desc: Jedná se o krátký animovaný příběh o člověku, který si chce dojít pro pivo do hospody naproti jeho domu přes ulici, ale kvůli silnému provozu se tam nemůže dostat. Nakonec tedy také použije svého automobilu, aby dorazil ke svému cíli. Povede se mu to? Československý krátkometrážní film

programme.title: Mstitel
programme.desc: Příběh muže, který se rozhodl vzít právo do svých rukou. Filmové drama na motivy románu Karla Matěje Čapka-Choda Kašpar Lén mstitel. Praha před první světovou válkou. Mladý zedník Kašpar Lén se po třech letech vojny vrací do civilu. Chce se ubytovat u přítele Kryštofa, sklepní byt je ale prázdný. Přítel je po smrti a z jeho dcery Márynky, na niž Kašpar celou vojnu myslel, se stala lehká holka. Lén zjistí, že příčinou všeho zla je bohatý kupec Konopík.

programme.title: Utrpení mladého Boháčka
programme.desc: Nestárnoucí komedie plná omylů, trapasů a zmatků kolem nevěsty na inzerát. Vtipná komedie o vesnickém mládenci, kterého maminka nutí do ženění. Už to zkusila i s inzeráty, ale žádná známost se nakonec nevyvedla. Tonda je totiž přesvědčen, že "ženský nejsou pro něj a on není na ženský". Až setkání s náhodnou stopařkou změní jeho dosavadní život. Pro začátek mu nezbývá nic jiného, než ji vydávat za snoubenku, aby měl od všetečné maminky pokoj.

programme.title: O lidech a tramvajích
programme.desc: Krátký osvětový snímek. Kvalitní městská hromadná doprava je společným cílem cestujících i pracovníků Dopravního podniku hlavního města Prahy. Najdou se však řidiči a průvodčí, kteří úmyslně ujedou z konečné stanice dřív a mají škodolibou radost z pohledu na dobíhající lidi... Československý krátkometrážní film

programme.title: Záchvěv strachu
programme.desc: Vyjít ven z vězení ještě neznamená být na svobodě. V roce 1857 se z olomoucké pevnosti se po létech věznění vrací do Prahy jeden z vůdců revoluce 1848 František Vinický. Jeho rodina a bývalí přátelé se netají obavami z policejního sledování. Jméno Františka Vinického má být zdiskreditováno falešnou informací o jeho konfidentství.

programme.desc: Na anglické panství se sjede umělecká smetánka v čele s Dalím a Magrittem kvůli průlomové výstavě a vzápětí jsou všichni zataženi do vyšetřování vraždy. Premiéra belgického detektivního seriálu inspirovaného surrealismem a příběhy Agathy Christie

programme.title: Hvězdy stříbrného plátna
programme.desc: Charismatický anglický gentleman, který okouzlil Hollywood a zahrál si epizodní roli v jednom českém filmu. Britský dokumentární cyklus (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Příběhy českých alb (2)
programme.desc: Příběh vzniku mimořádného sólového alba ikony českého poprocku ve spojení s trojicí producentů, za které její interpretka a skladatelka získala Cenu Anděl pro Zpěvačku roku. Novým dokumentárním cyklem provází Milan Cais. Účinkují: L. Dusilová, B. Hlavenková, V. Béreš, P. Karpentski, M. Cimfe, P. Karlík a další (skryté titulky)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (37)
programme.desc: When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed - but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front - but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (38)
programme.desc: Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (35)
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (36)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find the cabin upside down. Upon closer inspection, it looks like an epic battle took place there. And Grizzy isn't here. The curious Lemmings start imagining what could have happened, visualizing the most improbable scenes for us. They decide to follow their lead to find Grizzy and confirm their zany theories.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (37)
programme.desc: Grizzy dreams of drinking some nice cold coconut milk on the couch. Step one, get rid of the Lemmings who are having fun flying through the living room. Two, find coconuts that haven't been emptied of their nectar. While Grizzy struggles to pick coconuts that are too high up, the Lemmings find a magic conch. By simply dusting yourself with its sand, you can fly!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: Grizzy wants to watch TV in peace. The Lemmings have other plans: they want to have fun playing music with homemade instruments. Exasperated by the racket they're making in the garage, Grizzy destroys the instruments and sends the Lemmings flying. The Lemmings discover a magic ukulele that bewitches anyone who hears its music: the perfect tool to regain control of the cabin and get back to their concert.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (39)
programme.desc: Grizzy can't sleep because it's too hot. He decides to confiscate the fans the Lemmings use to power their fake spaceship. Totally into their Space Opera game, the Lemmings try to repel the alien Grizzy with "laser" party favors and are propelled onto an "unknown planet": a volcano crater with a secret base where a rocket is ready to take off. The rocket carries the cabin into space. It's no longer a game: Grizzy and the Lemmings will have to face the dangers of outer space!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (40)
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (41)
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (42)
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (43)
programme.desc: Grizzy has played for too many hours on the console. His eyes are so fatigued he cannot stand a single ray of light. The Lemmings choose this very moment to throw a big birthday party with as many lights as possible! Grizzy goes to great lengths to settle the issue and decides to trip the power supply. The Lemmings discover a source of magical light deep in the savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (44)
programme.desc: Grizzy watches the Lemmings play Hide-n-Seek and cannot refrain from sabotaging their game by revealing their hiding places. The Lemmings challenge him to play against them. The two sides outdo each other in cunning and trickery, but they are equally good. For the last decisive round, the opponents decide to extend the game zone to the entire savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (45)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have organized a mega party at the cabin. This is obviously not to Grizzy’s liking and the bear throws them out. The Lemmings discover a cave where the party is even more fun, but their ruckus drives out the bats who seek refuge in the cabin. Terrified of them, Grizzy tries everything to get rid of them and understands that the most effective thing is the Lemmings’ ghetto blaster.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (46)
programme.desc: Grizzy needs the fridge to keep his fish cold, but the Lemmings want it to make ice for their miniature ice skating rink. When Grizzy finds a new model robot air conditioner that is both rapid and efficient, the problem seems to be solved: each party will have their own source of cold. But when the Lemmings activate the robot’s artificial intelligence, the gadget starts to feel a powerful love for the person who resembles him most in his new surroundings: the fridge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (47)
programme.desc: Grizzy finds a white bear that fell out of a zoo’s refrigerated truck. After consulting the encyclopedia, he realizes that he and the bear are brothers of the same species! He decides to follow the encyclopedia’s instructions to the letter and take care of his brother during his hibernation. This runs counter to all of the Lemmings favorite activities. The Lemmings decide to create a false encyclopedia page which says that they too are bears.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (48)
programme.desc: The Lemmings’ hard rock concert is driving Grizzy mad. After kicking them out, Grizzy requisitions their ghetto blaster and listens to a relaxation cassette to calm down. The Lemmings discover an ancestral tree whose engraved strips of bark cast targeted maledictions. To recover their material, the Lemmings decide to drive Grizzy out by cursing him with the Ten Plaques of the Savanna.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (49)
programme.desc: Inspired by a magazine, Grizzy decides to redo the cabin’s interior design. To make sure everything is perfect, he ousts the Lemmings and their electric train. By chance, the Lemmings discover an underground futuristic premises in the middle of the savanna. From this secret place, they can see the entire savanna on a giant screen, down to the very inside of Grizzy’s cabin just like in a sandbox video game. By using the menus, they can have an impact on reality and thus... on Grizzy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (20)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is waiting for Irma at the park for a picnic, when he sees a nervous man rehearsing an engagement proposal to his girlfriend. Mr Bean tries to show him how it’s done but manages to send the engagement ring flying! It lands in a bicycle basket, gets flicked into a pram, flung onto an ice cream - Mr Bean has to chase it around the park as it keeps being launched from place to place, in the hope he can save the day!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is under strict instructions to water Mr Paliwal’s precious plant once a day while he’s on holiday. It’s all going fine, and Mr Bean is enjoying playing with his neighbour’s gadgets while he’s away. However, one day he forgets his task and has to let himself in late at night - but Mr Bean’s other neighbour, Bruiser, spots the suspicious activity, and thinks Mr Paliwal’s got a burglar!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (22)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is dismayed to find that the bin men are refusing to take his wheelie bin because the lid won’t shut as it’s too full of rubbish - and by the time he’s shut it, they’ve gone! So he sneaks the bin in front of other houses, hoping they won’t notice and pick it up. Meanwhile, Mrs Wicket realises that her purse has ended up in the rubbish, and is chasing Mr Bean… who is chasing the bin men!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport - she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure - a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Lamput (35)
programme.desc: Lamput shows kindness to a nearby spider - and in the process makes a valuable ally. Good thing, too, because the mozzies around here are diabolical.

programme.title: Moley (47)
programme.desc: When the Gardener finally gets his hands on Manny, Moley and Dotty are on his trail, so he dresses up as the world’s greatest Mole detective and lead them away from the clues.

programme.title: Moley (48)
programme.desc: Mishmosh’s new de-aging device causes trouble when it accidentally zaps Miss Petunia and Old Coot into their younger selves. But Moley soon discovers that the de-aging doesn’t stop and he and his friends must rescue them before it’s too late.

programme.title: Moley (49)
programme.desc: Moley and Dotty go on a wild adventure after getting transformed into worms, only to discover that Squirm comes from a whole new alien world that has been under MoleTown the entire time!

programme.title: Moley (50)
programme.desc: When Mishmosh falls ill and is unable to compete in MoleTown’s greatest inventor competition, Moley and Dotty must dress up and compete in his place against other great Mole inventors!

programme.title: Moley (51)
programme.desc: It’s the anniversary of Moley becoming the keeper of Manny, and Dotty, with a little help from her Uncle Mishmosh, goes back in time to see what she had missed before she came to MoleTown.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time (14)
programme.desc: It’s Halloween, so the crew decorates their garage for the Looneyburg Trick-Or-Treaters.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (10)
programme.desc: Chep wants to be brave enough to join in the daring games that Mush-Mush and Lilit like to play. So he gets some protective moss pants that make him not only indestructible but also fashionable… and a bit cocky. Woo, it’s the new Chep!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (11)
programme.desc: Mush-Mush really wants to get over his fear of snakes. Truff really wants to get over his fear of ants. So they team up to help each other overcome their fears… maybe.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (12)
programme.desc: Mushpot offers to look after the Mushies so Mushpie can get a well-earned rest. He thinks it will be easy. It is not easy! The Mushies end up pushing both Mushpot and Starmush to their limit.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (13)
programme.desc: Sushi-Mushi’s excitement and pride over Chanterelle doing a portrait of him to hang in his restaurant turns to worry. What if his friends don’t like it? But, of course, Chanterelle would never let that happen.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables (14)
programme.desc: Wanting to show the Mushies that they should fly high and follow their dreams, Mushpie starts leaf-gliding for the first time. But soon she is flying way too high!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power (52)
programme.desc: Kid Kazoom, Multy, and Kid Fury team up one last time to divert the Titan Fury. Kaboom City is saved and it's time to go home.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (31)
programme.desc: As Rick and Ginger prepare for a costume party, Tom tries to score some snacks. Jerry and Tuffy are out to do the same. Spike and Tom are initially confused by the guests' costumes. Determined to get their paws on as much party food as they can, however, they contrive their own costumes to crash the party. Will they get away with it?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (32)
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Catsylvania, zombie cats pop up out of the ground as Tom passes a cemetery, so Tom runs to Jerry Van Mouseling for help. At first, the mouse thinks Tom is a zombie cat or Frankenstein-cat and tries repelling him. However, once Jerry understands the problem, he and his band of angry peasant mice help fight the zombie cats.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (33)
programme.desc: Rick and Ginger wake up late and, in their hurry, they accidentally put dog food in Tom's bowl and cat food in Spike's. This causes Spike to behave like a cat and Tom to act like a dog. Although they're confused at first, they soon eat other types of food and discover how it makes them act.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (34)
programme.desc: While Rick and Ginger take a mountain hike, Tom and Jerry befriend three cute baby eaglets and help them learn to fly. However, soon Tom must face a bobcat.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show (35)
programme.desc: Spike orders Tom and Jerry to watch Tyke while he's away, but instead Tom takes the opportunity to chase Jerry in the backyard. Suddenly, Tyke is nowhere to be seen and the front gate is wide open! Tom and Jerry must find the pup in time or face Spike's beating.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (36)
programme.desc: While Grizzy fishes, a penguin comes over and sees that the bear's bucket is empty. He decides to help him and catches piles of fish. Impressed, the bear brings the penguin back to the cabin, where a friendship rapidly strikes up. This pleasant and friendly new companion quickly arouses the Lemmings' curiosity. They lure the penguin away on the sly and replace him with another one who's not nearly as clever. Grizzy will quickly see through the trickery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (37)
programme.desc: Just as Grizzy settles into the couch by the fireside, the Lemmings come charging into the living room on their new mount, the vacuum cleaner. Irritated, the bear throws the mechanical charger into the fireplace, which blows up. Freezing air sweeps into the cabin. Seeking a source of heat, Grizzy decides to move into the science station greenhouse where the temperature is controlled by a drone. But the bear is unaware of what he carries in his luggage: the Lemmings!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (38)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a new playmate: a walrus! The rodents ride the creature throughout the cabin, then make him slide down the roof before starting all over again. Grizzy steps in and propels the creature to the back of a mysterious ice cave. In the center is a dolmen with a bone sitting on it. Whoever touches the bone becomes docile and prehistoric in appearance. The Lemmings dream up a scheme where Grizzy would submit to their will.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (9)
programme.desc: Jon, Min, and Miguel can’t wait to explore their new home base! But their welcome party takes a turn when the island’s most feared predator crashes the scene: Big Rex! Uncle Jack ushers them into safety in Dino Explorers HQ! Unbeknown to the ranchers, a duo of rascally compy's have stolen the HQ's system key throwing everything into chaos.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers (10)
programme.desc: The Ranchers take the Jungle Jetter on an underwater joyride—but their fun comes to a screeching halt when they catch the eye of Thunderfin, the island’s ill-tempered mosasaurus! With jaws snapping and tail thrashing, Thunderfin charges after them, forcing the kids to dive into the shadows of a nearby cave for cover!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (11)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean is shocked when Teddy receives a birthday card from Bean’s girlfriend, Irma Gobb. The bear’s Birthday had completely slipped his mind. And what do you get for the teddy that has everything? A morning in a toy shop, burgers for lunch and a slap up tea party, of course. (But only if you can afford it.)

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (12)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean’s landlady is hopping mad on finding molehills on her lovely croquet lawn. Bean looks to get hammered if he does not rid the old lady of the cuddly little half-blind culprit. He fails dismally with his eccentric mole extermination methods and ends up simply taking the pesky rodent for a ride.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (31)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (32)
programme.desc: As the storm rages, Baby Owl's tree is struck by lightning! She's left without a nest. The Baby Lemmings seek shelter from the wind, and find refuge in a crumbling cave. They decide to decorate it in a makeover style. Unintentionally, they take the items Baby Owl had prepared for her new nest. She comes to get them back, but the Baby Lemmings don't understand why.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings (1)
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard.

programme.title: Batwheels (13)
programme.desc: Super-genius villain Egghead is on the loose, planning to use Gotham Museum’s famed giant egg to cook up a record-breaking breakfast.

programme.title: Batwheels (18)
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (13)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (14)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to find a nice quiet place to read his book so he sets off for the Library. But instead of reading he becomes distracted by some funny online videos he sees on the Library’s computer. Before he knows it Mr Bean is recording his own video which is uploaded for everyone to see. Things start to go crazy when people check out his funny video and his popularity takes off. But does Mr Bean enjoy being in the public eye and how long will his celebrity last?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (23)
programme.desc: Mr Bean drops Irma off at the airport - she and Lottie are going on a lovely sunny holiday without them. To cheer Teddy up, Mr Bean has a brainwave - don’t worry, we’ll have a holiday right here at home! So Mr Bean goes about recreating all the things he saw in Irma’s brochure - a flight on an Bean Airways and a stay at Hotel Bean with sea view and a pool! Hope Irma is having a great time too…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: How does one choose tasteful wallpaper these days? After watching a royal documentary on TV, Mr. Bean decides to decorate his room in the style of Buckingham Palace. If the Queen’s new wallpaper is good enough for Her Royal Highness, then it’s going to be good enough for him. Meanwhile, his landlady, Mrs. Wicket, suffers from illusions of grandeur and crowns herself Queen of the street.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (24)
programme.desc: At a funfair, Mr Bean wins a balloon for Teddy and ties it to him while he plays on the hook a duck. But he’s so engrossed he doesn’t notice his companion floating away! Soon Mr Bean is chasing Teddy as he glides and snags on various fairground rides. Will Mr Bean rescue Teddy before he floats away forever?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (25)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket has just inherited an antique grandfather clock - Mr Bean is impressed! But he soon starts to resent it when it bongs loudly on the hour all through the night. Desperate for sleep as dawn is breaking, he fiddles inside the clock, only for it to fall apart and onto the floor! Can he get the bulky heirloom to a repair shop and back before Mrs Wicket wakes up?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (15)
programme.desc: The gang travels back to Ancient Greece, where they play unique roles in a Greek Mystery involving the mythological spider woman, Arachne, and her attempts to disrupt the royal wedding that would unite two great cities!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (16)
programme.desc: Shaggy's friend Amelia invites Shaggy and the gang to a party. But Shaggy discovers that Amelia has become a goth. After realizing he has feelings for her Shaggy starts to feel bad that he hasn't changed at all so he decides he too will become a goth. But a mystery appears when an evil plant monster attacks the gang.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (66)
programme.desc: The Lemmings have fun bouncing off the backs of green frogs while Grizzy chases some mosquitos buzzing around him. Displeased, the rodents replace Grizzy's green frogs with poisonous orange ones that paralyze anyone who touches them!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (67)
programme.desc: Grizzy comes home and discovers the Lemmings dancing madly and throws them into the jungle where they meet a parrot that can reproduce any sound. The bird becomes their ally to distract Grizzy and recover their musical equipment.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (68)
programme.desc: The Lemmings organize an obstacle course in their cabin. Grizzy ejects the Lemmings from the cabin and they crash onto an Incan temple where they discover a spheric object that can control the Earth's rotation.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (69)
programme.desc: The Lemmings get hold of an old pinball machine and install it in the cabin. Their furious party interrupts Grizzy's nap and the bear threatens to break the contraption.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (70)
programme.desc: Grizzy, a big chocolate lover, is growing a young cacao tree under an ultraviolet lamp. During a trampoline session, the Lemmings accidentally break the lamp, provoking a supernatural reaction.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (71)
programme.desc: During a fight, Grizzy and the Lemmings stumble upon a Mayan temple lost in the jungle. Once inside, they set off a magic reaction that creates doubles of themselves at different ages.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (6)
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around - yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (7)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is trying to watch the motor racing on TV, when Mrs Wicket interrupts him to offer a deal - revamp her garden with new paving and ornaments, and he’ll get a month’s rent for free. Bean reluctantly agrees, but when he sees Mr Paliwal finish a personal training session and keen for more, he offers him a new workout… doing all Mr Bean’s work for him while he watches the racing! Win, win!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (8)
programme.desc: Mr Bean is bored of queuing for a trampoline park, so secretly bounces in through a window using a trampette. But he soon gets on the wrong side of a young show-off boy who keeps stealing Teddy and throwing him in hard-to-reach spots. To settle their row, they agree on a race around the trampoline park - first place wins Teddy. Will Mr Bean triumph before he’s chucked out for jumping the queue?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (9)
programme.desc: Irma is struggling to sell items from her knitwear stall at the market, so sends Mr Bean to collect a sheep costume he can wear to attract customers. Once at the fancy dress shop however, Mr Bean gets stuck in the sheep costume and has to travel back to the market wearing it. Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (49)
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series (21)
programme.desc: Mr. Bean finds himself lumbered with an unwanted pet in the form of a four-legged ball of pink fur with piggy eyes and a penchant for earthworms. Encyclopedias leave him none the wiser as to the identity of the pesky creature but Bean can’t bring himself to just abandon it. The puzzle is eventually solved after a picnic in the park and a raid on the local pet shop.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko (8)
programme.desc: Jerry and Tuffy go to the Cheese Festival. Tom is cooking in the food truck and turns Jerry into a hotdog. Tom chases after Jerry and Tuffy as they escape.

programme.title: Batwheels (6)
programme.desc: Bam must learn to adapt and try something new as he’s tasked to dive the Bat Big Rig all the way to Star City, while the Legion of Zoom chases after him.

programme.title: Batwheels (18)
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels (9)
programme.desc: An errant piece of bubblegum stuck inside Bam threatens to blow up Batman's chance at stopping Joker on a fast-paced mission through the Gotham streets.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (12)
programme.desc: Shaggy takes the Gang to the Minor League Baseball stadium of his youth only to learn that it's about to be shut down because a Ghostly Baseball Player is scaring away the fans - and the team! Shaggy puts aside his cowardly ways to save his home team. But will Scooby stand by his (now not-so-scared) pal?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! (13)
programme.desc: When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings (13)

programme.desc: Mentre il rapporto con Nina si fa più profondo aprendo a Rosario la possibilità di una vita familiare, il lavoro continua a strapparlo alla normalità. Livatino dimostra la sua idea di giustizia anche davanti a un detenuto disperato.

programme.title: Livatino - Il giudice e i suoi assassini - l prezzo del coraggio (4)
programme.desc: Rosario è ormai giudice e firma i decreti di confisca contro Gagliano e altri mafiosi, colpendo Cosa Nostra nel punto più sensibile: il denaro. Le minacce diventano sempre più esplicite, anche contro la sua famiglia, ma Livatino continua a rifiutare la scorta e ogni logica di paura. Nel rapporto con Nina affiora tutto il peso della sua scelta mentre i mandanti decidono che il giudice "ha superato il segno"...

programme.title: Porta a porta - Puntata del 10/11/2026
programme.desc: Giunto alla trentunesima edizione, il programma di Bruno Vespa offre al pubblico grandi novità, pur confermando la linea editoriale legata agli avvenimenti della politica, come ai grandi fatti di cronaca e alle mutazioni della società.

programme.title: Porta a porta - Puntata del 10/11/2026
programme.desc: Giunto alla trentunesima edizione, il programma di Bruno Vespa offre al pubblico grandi novità, pur confermando la linea editoriale legata agli avvenimenti della politica, come ai grandi fatti di cronaca e alle mutazioni della società.

programme.title: Pokrevní pouto
programme.desc: New York, 1974. Padesátiletý Chris, který si odpykával dlouholetý trest za vraždu, byl za dobré chování právě propuštěn z vězení. Venku na něj čeká jeho mladší bratr Frank, policista s perspektivní budoucností. Chris a Frank byli vždy odlišní, ale pokrevní vazby mezi nimi vždy fungovaly dokonale a pevně. Chris dostává šanci k návratu do běžného života. Frank ho ubytovává u sebe doma a nachází mu práci. Chris už ale není schopen žít „normální“ život.

programme.title: Turbotarantule 2: Druhá láva
programme.desc: Když se po celé Floridě začnou nečekaně objevovat nebezpečně hluboké závrty, k životu se probudí nové hnízdo turbotarantulí. Gigantická zákeřná monstra plivající lávu rychle rozpoutají ničivou zkázu a chaos na jinak prosluněné Floridě. Jako by to nestačilo, turbotarantule zaútočí na pláž, kde si půvabná mladá dívka jménem Raya (Michele Weaver) chtěla užít prázdninové volno.

programme.title: Umělá inteligence
programme.desc: Británie je uprostřed studené války s Čínou a její ministerstvo obrany pracuje na vývoji robotického vojáka. Když se bojový stroj vymkne kontrole a dojde ke krveprolití, šéf vývojářského týmu povolá na pomoc expertku na oblast umělé inteligence. Jejich vztah brzy začne překračovat pouto ryze pracovní, a právě tehdy se věci začnou komplikovat.

programme.title: Cesta za pokladem
programme.desc: Cesta za pokladem nebo mýty a legendy ze světa peněz je šestidílný veselý příběh pro děti o sourozencích Maxovi a Mili, kteří se vydají na cestu za pokladem, aby mohli koupit narozeninový dárek své mamince. Maxovi a Mili na jejich cestě pomáhá babi Majka a její pejsek Money. V každé epizodě se děti naučí něco zajímavého ze světa peněz a navíc zjistí, co vše může být vzácné jako poklad. Slovenský naučně-zábavný seriál

programme.title: Kikirikí
programme.desc: Kohoutek a slepička se stali nerozlučnými kamarády. Mají se velmi rádi, v noci spí vedle sebe na bidýlku a přes den spolu gazdují na dvoře. Kohoutek neustále něco vymýšlí, je nespokojený a slepička s ním všechno trpělivě řeší. Každý příběh v sobě ukrývá ponaučení, jak se stát lepším a neubližovat lidem, kteří nás mají rádi. Slovenská pohádka

programme.title: Sníček (5)
programme.desc: Hugo splní dětem každý sen! V noci snové víly přinášejí dětem sny. Ale co dělají přes den? Hugo se nudí, a tak si usmyslí, že Lucii a Damiána bude navštěvovat i během dne. Jelikož se však neumí v našem světě chovat, děti ho musí učit základy slušné výchovy. On jim za to vysvětlí, jak fungují nejznámější hodiny na světě Big Ben, a ukáže, jak žijí různá zvířata. Vezme je do džungle, pod mořskou hladinu, do vesmíru, a také do svého snového světa, kde je možné opravdu všechno.

programme.title: Zabij nudu!
programme.desc: Dochází vám fantazie, co dělat doma s dětmi? Je tu pořad, v němž dostanete návod, jak spolu smysluplně prožít společně strávený čas. A také jak vyrobit jedinečné věci, které oživí vaši domácnost. Zažijete přitom určitě spoustu zábavy! Jsou to věci funkční, dekorační nebo jen pro zábavu, například pomůcky do školy, pokladničky či žertovné ozdoby. Slovenský tvůrčí pořad

programme.title: Staré pověsti české (20)
programme.desc: Animované Staré pověsti české vznikly ve vlastní produkci televizí CS Film a CS Mini. Producenti televize hledali velký příběh, který by připomínal tradice a naši minulost. Jan Werich o Jiráskovi, podle jehož námětu byl seriál natočen, řekl: „Kdyby Jirásek žil v Hollywoodu, byl by milionář, protože měl výborné zápletky.“ Oslavoval český národ, ale ne na úkor jiných. Tu a tam zušlechťoval naši historii a prokládal ji sentimentálními příběhy, a tak nám ji přibližoval a činil bližší.

programme.title: O modrém autíčku (10)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál o dobrodružstvích modrého autíčka a jeho kamarádů. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Já Baryk (10)
programme.desc: Dvanáct příběhů, z nichž každý je věnovaný vždy jednomu měsíci v roce a jednomu zvířeti, se kterým se dobromyslný pes Baryk ve svém okolí potká, to je spousta veselých i napínavých příhod.

programme.title: O Mikešovi (18)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál O kocouru Mikešovi a jeho přátelích, podle knihy Josefa Lady. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Mach a Šebestová (9)
programme.desc: Kreslený seriál o příhodách spolužáků Macha a Šebestové podle námětu Miloše Macourka. Československý animovaný seriál (1976-1983).

programme.title: Krakonošovy pohádky (6)
programme.desc: Jednou šel Krakonoš kolem chalupy dřevaře Josky Košků, a to právě v den, kdy se Joska ženil. Pán hor musel přece také přispět nějakým darem, a tak mu na dveře pověsil hodiny - kukačky. Jenomže dřív, než se Joska vrátil domů s nevěstou, šel kolem známý poberta Bertík. Dlouho se nerozmýšlel a šup s kukačkami do pytle. Večer se Krakonoš jako chudý pocestný vypravil k Joskovi, ale ať koukal, jak koukal, svůj dar nikde neviděl. Vtom zaslechl kukání, kolem totiž kráčel Bertík s pytlem.

programme.title: Žofka a její dobrodružství (13)
programme.desc: Veselé příběhy podnikavé opičky Žofky Orangutanové a jejích zvířecích kamarádů v zoologické zahradě. Československý animovaný seriál .

programme.title: Broučci (1)
programme.desc: Animovaný loutkový seriál na motivy knihy Jana Karafiáta. Karafiátova kniha s ilustracemi Jiřího Trnky inspirovala už celou řadu adaptací a stále patří do zlatého fondu české dětské literatury. Tato filmová verze Broučků citlivě pracuje se známými hodnotami a snaží se je co nejvíce přiblížit dnešním dětem. Český animovaný loutkový seriál

programme.title: Brundibáři (4)
programme.desc: Kratičké příběhy dvou čmeláků, kteří se stejně jmenují a navlas se sobě i podobají. Československý animovaný seriál

programme.title: Tisíc a jedna noc (2)
programme.desc: Animovaný seriál, jehož jednotlivé části vyprávějí příhody ze známé knihy Pohádky tisíce a jedné noci. Český animovaný seriál

programme.title: Jindra, hraběnka Ostrovínová
programme.desc: Po letech strávených v cizině se mladá dívka vrací na rodný statek. Třetí filmová adaptace nejúspěšnějšího románu Ivana Klicpery Jindra . Po letech strávených ve Vídni, se vrací Jindra Jarýnová se sestřenicí Amálkou na statek svého otce. Ten jí představí učitele svých synků, vlastence Lípu. Jindře se učitel líbí, ale nedá mu to najevo, protože zjistí, že ho miluje Amálka. Jednoho dne na statku vypukne požár, který pomáhá Lípa hasit.

programme.title: Filmové minuty
programme.desc: Filmové minuty přinášejí souhrnné filmové zpravodajství ze světa filmu, aktuality, ocenění, výročí, nové a připravované projekty a mnoho dalšího z domova i ze zahraničí... Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Bourák
programme.desc: Mají ho plný zuby... ale i srdce! Komedie Ondřeje Trojana s Ivanem Trojanem v roli Bouráka, věčného frajera, kterému teče do baráku i do života a rodina už ho má plný zuby... ale i srdce. Příběh se odehrává ve Šlukdorfu, imaginárním městě na severu Čech, kde po revoluci zavřeli všechny fabriky a místo nich se vyrojily nonstop herny, kasina a šlapky. V jednom z těch nonstopů s automaty pro zoufalce pracuje i Kamila, osmnáctka, která už má života ve městě, kde chcípnul pes, plné zuby.

programme.title: Od zítřka nečaruji
programme.desc: Komedie o dopadení pana Tau. Další neuvěřitelné příhody pana Tau, laskavého kouzelníka s čarovnou buřinkou. Pan Tau musí skončit se svým čarováním. Jeho kouzelná buřinka bude totiž nenávratně zničena. Mlčenlivý kouzelník se stane kuchařem na letním dětském táboře a s pomocí dětí se naučí nejenom mluvit, ale i vařit bez použití čarovné buřinky. Pan Tau se objeví na křídle letícího letadla. Zděšená posádka všechno nahlásí, ale po přistání je záhadný černý pasažér pryč. Případu se ujme horlivý III.

programme.title: Kudy kráčela smrt (12)
programme.desc: Leskovice 1945. Pouhý den před koncem války tu přišly o život desítky lidí. Nejmladší oběti bylo teprve 13 let…Události v Leskovicích byly součástí rozsáhlého masakru civilního obyvatelstva, ke kterému tehdy, těsně na konci války v oblasti Českomoravské vysočiny došlo. O život tu tehdy přišlo, vinou německých nacistů, více než sto civilistů…Stanislav Motl se vydal po stopách několika lidí, kteří za události v Leskovicích nesli odpovědnost.

programme.title: Golem
programme.desc: S umělou bytostí se probouzí neovladatelná síla. Praha v posledním roce panování nemocného císaře Rudolfa II. Všemocný císařský komoří Lang se pokouší na Jakubovi, žáku již zemřelého Rabiho Löwa, vynutit tajemství umělé bytosti Golema. Probuzení neovladatelné síly podnítí lidové povstání. Pražští Židé trpí pod jhem nejvyššího komořího Langa. Rabi Löw kdysi stvořil Golema, hliněného obra s nadpřirozenou silou, kterého ukryl na půdě.

programme.title: Kinosál
programme.desc: V pořadu o nových filmech v kinech každý týden informujeme o nejzajímavějších a nejočekávanějších titulech v naší distribuci. V krátkých reportážích se zaměříme na zákulisí vzniku filmů, kuriozity z natáčení a výpovědi tvůrců. Přineseme rozhovory s českými a slovenskými filmaři, kteří v našich končinách stále více natáčejí své autorské projekty, a zachytíme jejich tvůrčí atmosféru. Filmová publicistika

programme.title: Pan Jordán a Habada
programme.desc: Mladá učitelka se odmítá smířit se zatuchlými poměry na škole, kde pedagogický sbor ovládá zapšklý despota. Příběh se odehrává v prostředí jedné pražské školy na sklonku předminulého století. Učitelský sbor tu ovládá učitel Jordán, kariérista, který se neštítí ani štvavých, anonymních výpadů v tisku proti byrokratickému inspektorovi Svobodovi a jeho „chráněnci“, učiteli Habadovi, který přišel z venkova. Když se mu to hodí, používá Jordán nevybíravé prostředky.

programme.title: Čardášová Julie
programme.desc: Humorná romance oživlých kostýmů v divadelní šatně. Československý animovaný film
